visual.general_description: Seven stacked rows, one per participant code P1 to P7, each with a left SSPS scatter plot and a right Dissociation scatter plot over timepoints T1 to T5, with blue dashed vertical lines and larger markers at assessment timepoints plus smaller weekly markers.
visual.detailed_description: Each row is headed by a participant code followed by a pseudonym first name in quotation marks and the printed baseline length: P1 2-week baseline, P2 6-week, P3 4-week, P4 2-week, P5 2-week, P6 4-week, P7 6-week. Left plots are titled SSPS with y-axis ticks 0 to 60 in steps of 10; right plots are titled Dissociation with y-axis ticks 0 to 25 in steps of 5. The x axis carries the timepoint labels T1 to T5 (printed "T 1" ... "T 5" in most rows, "T1 ... T5" in the last row). Blue dashed vertical lines mark T2, T4 and T5 (a line at T2 and T4 and T5; the T3 label has no line). Larger circular markers sit at assessment timepoints and smaller asterisk-like markers are weekly measures. A footer states SSPS = Social Safeness and Pleasure Scale; T = Timepoint. Qualitatively: in the P2 row SSPS rises across the course while Dissociation falls; P3 SSPS rises early and then stays at a similar level with Dissociation low and flat; P4 SSPS rises gradually while Dissociation stays nearly flat; P5 SSPS first fluctuates then rises while Dissociation falls from a flat start; P6 SSPS rises gradually with Dissociation fluctuating; P7 shows fluctuating, roughly flat series in both plots. The P1 row has weekly markers only over part of the span, with larger markers at T1, T2 and T5 only (none at T3 or T4), and a gap in weekly markers before T5. In the P7 SSPS plot the larger marker at T3 is drawn hollow, unlike the filled larger markers elsewhere.

visual.general_description: Two stacked grouped bar charts titled PSYRATS Voices - distress and PSYRATS Delusions - distress, each with groups P1 to P7 on the x axis and up to five shaded bars per group for T1 (base), T2 (start), T3 (mid), T4 (end) and T5 (FU), with y-axis ticks 0 to 10.
visual.detailed_description: Each chart has a y axis with ticks 0 to 10 in steps of 1, horizontal grid lines, grouped bars in five grey shades from dark to light, and a legend below reading T1 (base), T2 (start), T3 (mid), T4 (end), T5 (FU). A footer reads PSYRATS = Psychotic Symptoms Ratings Scales; T = Timepoint. In the voices chart groups P4 and P7 show no bars. In the delusions chart group P5 shows no bars. In the voices chart the later bars for P2 and P3 are absent or negligible while earlier timepoints show tall bars, and bars for P5 and P6 become shorter at the end timepoints. In the delusions chart the later bars for P2 and P3 are absent or negligible, bars for P1 and P6 become shorter at the end timepoints, P4 shows a stepwise shortening, and P7 shortens at the later timepoints. No numeric data labels are printed on bars.
